baseline_definitions.fixed: VERIFIED + detected + confidence>=0.9 -> AUTO_REMEDIATE; else detected -> HUMAN_REVIEW; else MONITOR_ONLY
baseline_definitions.random: Python random.Random(seed), one draw per held-out alert

split: 5-fold over detected alerts only; each alert evaluated once on a policy that did not train on it

not_routed.note: Flows below the detector threshold never become alerts. They are detector misses or true negatives, not response decisions, and are excluded from policy scoring.

approval_simulator_assumption: CONFIRM_TO_ACT is assumed approved offline so its reward can be observed; this is not live approval.
